_note: Base `liturgy-fixed.json` ships all 22 verses one per line, with `shortFormAfter: 10` marking the traditional short-form endpoint, so a parish reads as many as its antidoron distribution needs without per-parish logic. A variant here is for a parish whose BOOK prints a different set or different wording. Note the target is a whole-array replacement: a variant does not select from the base verses, it replaces them. With fewer than 10 verses the `shortFormAfter` divider never fires, which is correct — the variant's verses are the whole reading.

variants.label: Short form (6 verses)

_provenance.source_citation: St. John of Damascus, Tyler — Divine Liturgy book, Psalm 33 at the antidoron

variants._note: Six verses corresponding to base verses 1, 2, 3, 8, 9 and 10. Base verses 4-7 ('I sought the Lord', 'Come unto Him', 'This poor man cried', 'The angel of the Lord') and 11-22 are NOT rendered by a parish on this variant — confirmed deliberate with the user on 2026-08-29, after diffing against the base per the standing rule that a variant REPLACES rather than selects. See memory project_variant_replace_not_select.
value: I will bless the Lord at all times. His praise shall be continuously in my mouth.
In the Lord my soul shall make her boast. Let the meek hear and be glad.
Oh magnify the Lord with me and let us exalt His name together.
Taste and see that the Lord is good. Blessed is the man who hopeth in Him.
Fear the Lord all ye His saints. For there is no lack for them that fear Him.
The rich have become poor and hungry, but they that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.
